مِزْعَقٌ Quick: so in the phrase سَيْرٌ مِزْعَقٌ [a quick pace or journeying]. (Ibn-' Abbád, K.) And one says also, نَزَعَ فِى القَوْسِ نَزْعًا مِزْعَقًا, (Ibn- ' Abbád, K,) i. e. [He drew the bow] quickly. (TA.) ＝
-A2- It signifies also مِقْلَاعٌ تُقْلَعُ بِهِ الأَرَضُونَ [app. meaning An implement with which the lands, or fields, are broken up]. (Ibn-' Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
